NI NANQI

Ni Nanqi

Translation, teaching and practice allow Michel Claeys’s works and Essence Therapy courses to continue to unfold in the Chinese context.

TRANSLATION & PRACTICE

Bringing the Work into Chinese Classrooms

Ni Nanqi has long been involved in the Chinese translation and teaching of Michel Claeys’s works in China, and led related studies for Essence Therapy and dreamwork.

In addition to text translation, he serves as a translator, teaching assistant, and leader in the classroom, continuing to connect the methods in the book with the practical experience of Chinese learners. Reading Michel Claeys’s Chinese works and walking into the course site, you can see this long-term work.
